items.title: UniSpark: Exploring Hybrid Attention for Multimodal Understanding and Generation
items.summary: We present UniSpark-9B, a unified multimodal model that investigates hybrid attention for visual understanding and generation. items.reason: 提出混合注意力机制，通过Mixture-of-Transformer-Experts架构在9B参数规模下统一处理多模态理解与生成任务，解决跨模态对齐难题。

items.title: Where Do Vision-Language Models Get Left and Right? Position-Code Counterfactuals in Qwen2.5-VL, Qwen3-VL and InternVL3
items.summary: A vision-language model may take left-right direction from the orientation of image content within patches, its vision transformer's (ViT) position code, or token positions and order in its language model (LLM). items.reason: 通过镜像反事实实验验证Qwen2.5-VL等模型依赖ViT位置编码而非图像内容方向来判断左右，揭示其空间感知机制。

items.title: SMIC: Shared Multiscale Input-Reference Conditioning across Transformer Layers for Natural Language Inference
items.summary: Natural Language Inference models can be sensitive to localized lexical changes. We introduce Shared Multiscale Input-Reference Conditioning (SMIC), which constructs a single input-dependent multiscale reference and reuses it across Transformer layers.
